construction_notes.text: Seven stories, 95 rental units, 10% affordable. Preliminary filing, July 2024.

PRE24-112 description: demolish existing buildings and build a seven-story mixed-use building with five stories of residential over two stories of parking, ground-floor commercial and residential lobby.

Earlier office proposal on the same APN: rezoning C18-043 and special use permit SP18-049 for a 94,996 sq ft five-level office and retail building, both approved 2019-11-19 (applicant Courtenay Bauer, Verse Design).
City records show planning consultation AD22-587 (Pacific Row Development LLC, filed 2022-09-16) and a demolition-only special use permit SP25-009 with status New.
SF YIMBY: site holds a vacant commercial building, formerly Khanh's restaurant; the property has been listed for sale by Alliance Bay Realty.
